D1.scope: append-only scoped observations; one original per identity; linear correction chain; per-scope serialized admission with strictly increasing admission time; cutoff reads bounded by the scope watermark; every command reserved; raw records kept by digest

D2.scope: pure adapters for usage, QA, publish approval and M7 attempts (event windows) and fixture-only YouTube Analytics day rows (Pacific days, DST-aware, query scope in identity) and TikTok video snapshots; derived features linking every raw input and transformation version

D3.scope: transparent cohort summaries; compare_cohorts@1; causal language only for one named randomized/platform-managed surface; project-disjoint then future-time holdout; pre-registered replay; scoped recommendation and Human decision lifecycle with currentness, repeat-rejection and governed proposal reference only; learning API and project Learning page (zh/en/vi)

recorded_not_fixed: M4 (Medium): YouTube observed_at is the Pacific day end, so a protocol registered after a day ends but before its data is available is refused (conservative direction)
L6 (Low): no focus handoff or live announcement after a final decision

review_limits: Codex reviewed by reading source; its sandbox could not run uv/pnpm. All test evidence below was run by the main agent.
